name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | Pineapple Express
description:
A sativa-dominant hybrid combining pineapple and cedar flavors, known for its energizing and creative effects. It’s a great choice for daytime use, helping boost productivity, focus, and creativity throughout the day.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
